name: Just Ship
description: Multi-agent framework for autonomous software development. A single ticket triggers a full pipeline: triage, planning, implementation, testing, PR, merge. Includes 23 battle-tested skills, 8 specialized agents (Backend, Frontend, Data Engineer, DevOps, QA, Security, Triage, Orchestrator), and slash commands for the complete dev lifecycle. Runs locally via CLI or 24/7 on a VPS.
longDescription:
Ships **42 skills**, **10 agents**, **19 commands** and **5 hooks**.

- **Skills** (42): `add-project` (Neues Projekt im aktuellen Workspace verknüpfen — nur Projekt-ID in project.json schreiben), `autonomy-boundary` (The operating system for decision-making in this team), `backend` (Use when implementing API endpoints, server-side business logic, webhook handlers, event pipelines, shared hooks, or backend integrations), `brainstorming` (You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior), `connect-board` (Board-Verbindung einrichten — via jsp_ Token oder Status prüfen), `creative-design` (Use when creating new UIs from scratch — landing pages, marketing sites, prototypes, or any greenfield frontend work…), `data-engineer` (Use when making database schema changes, writing migrations, configuring RLS policies, syncing TypeScript types, or designing data models…), `design-lead` (Your Head of Design + Head of Product-UX), and 34 more
- **Agents** (10): `backend` (Backend-Entwickler für API-Endpoints, Shared Hooks und Business Logic), `code-review` (Code Review Agent — reviewt den Diff gegen main auf Code-Qualität, Patterns, Edge Cases, Error Handling, Performance und…), `data-engineer` (Datenbank-Spezialist für Migrations, RLS Policies, Schema-Änderungen und TypeScript-Typen), `devops` (DevOps Engineer für Build-Checks, TypeScript-Compilation und Lint), `frontend` (Design-affiner Frontend-Entwickler), `orchestrator` (Orchestriert die autonome Entwicklung), `qa` (Testing Engineer für Teststrategie, Testentwicklung und Acceptance-Criteria-Verifikation), `security` (Security Reviewer für Auth, RLS, Input Validation und Secrets), and 2 more
- **Commands** (19): `add-project` (Neues Projekt im aktuellen Workspace verknüpfen — nur Projekt-ID in project.json schreiben), `connect-board` (Board-Verbindung einrichten — via jsp_ Token oder Status prüfen), `creative-design` (Creative Design — Greenfield UI/UX von Scratch designen mit Anti-AI-Slop Standards), `develop` (Nächstes ready_to_develop Ticket holen und autonom implementieren), `disconnect-board` (Board-Verbindung entfernen — zurück zu CLI-only), `frontend-design` (Frontend Design — UI-Komponenten mit Design-System-Qualität implementieren), `implement` (Implementiere was gerade besprochen wurde — ohne Ticket, mit vollem Agent-Workflow), `init` (Projekt-Setup — Stack erkennen, project.json erstellen), and 11 more
- **Hooks** (5): `SessionStart`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `SessionEnd`, `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install just-ship@claude-community` from `yves-s/just-ship`.
